personal-statement: DevOps/Platform Engineer, building tools and automations for other engineers at a 150-person MSP to streamline processes and make work easier.

Integrating Entra and vendor platforms (Domotz, MySonicWall, Liongard) for complete user provisioning/deprovisioning across third-party apps (4 hours saved per onboarding)
Automating tickets for manual drift correction across hundreds of client machines/environments (1-3 hours saved per campaign)
Coordinating and planning automation efforts across departments and teams, gathering requirements and constraints

Leading HIPAA and PCI compliance audits, and implementing appropriate security and technical controls in response
Interfacing with clients on strategy and technical issues
